name: Minestrone Soup with Shells
description: A hearty minestrone soup with small shell macaroni, kidney beans, and vegetables, topped with Parmesan cheese.
recipeIngredient: ¾ cup (175 mL) small shell macaroni
1 can (14 oz/398 mL) red or white kidney beans, drained
3 cans (10 oz/284 mL each) chicken broth
1 can (19 oz/540 mL) tomatoes, coarsely chopped with liquid

recipeInstructions.text: In a large saucepan, cook the chopped bacon until crisp. Add the onion, carrot, celery, and cabbage; cook, stirring occasionally, for about 5 minutes.
Stir in the water, chicken broth, and tomatoes with their liquid. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.
Stir in the small shell macaroni and cook, uncovered, for 15 minutes longer.
Add the kidney beans, garlic, and parsley to the soup; heat through.
Serve topped with grated Parmesan cheese.

keywords: minestrone soup, pasta soup, Italian-American cuisine

_similar.name: Pasta & Bean Soup
_similar.description: A hearty and flavorful soup featuring pasta, beans, and vegetables in a tomato-based broth.
recipeIngredient: 19 oz can white kidney or romano beans, drained
10 oz can chicken broth, diluted with 1 cup water
3 cups small shell pasta or macaroni

recipeInstructions.text: Place oil in a large pan over medium heat. Stir in onion, carrots, celery, and garlic. Cook, uncovered, stirring often, until onion is soft, about 5 minutes.
Add broth, tomatoes and juice, seasoning, and beans. Break up tomatoes. Increase heat to medium and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Uncover, increase heat, and bring to a boil. Add pasta or macaroni. Boil gently, uncovered, stirring often, for about 8 minutes.
If desired, add additional hot broth or water for more broth. Stir in basil and Parmesan. Serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: pasta soup, bean soup, Italian soup, vegetable broth

_similar.name: Pizza Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty pizza-inspired casserole with pasta, pepperoni, and mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Melt margarine and sauté chopped onion until soft.
Add tomato sauce, mushrooms, oregano, and basil. Stir and remove from heat.
Cook pasta in boiling water with oil and salt for 8 to 10 minutes until tender but firm. Drain.
Combine cooked pasta with Parmesan cheese and 1 cup mozzarella cheese in a 3-quart casserole.
Scatter pepperoni slices over the pasta mixture.
Cover with the tomato-onion sauce and sprinkle with remaining mozzarella cheese.
Bake, uncovered, in a 350°F oven for 30 minutes.

_similar.keywords: pizza casserole, pasta bake, pepperoni, mozzarella cheese

_similar.name: Dad's Spaghetti
_similar.description: A comforting spaghetti dish with bacon, mushrooms, and a creamy mushroom soup sauce.
recipeIngredient: 1 to 2 tsp garlic salt or 1 to 2 minced garlic cloves

recipeInstructions.text: Cook spaghetti, drain, and set aside.
Brown bacon in a frying pan with garlic salt or minced garlic.
Remove bacon and most of the grease from the pan.
Cook onion and mushrooms in the same pan until tender.
Return bacon to the pan and add mushroom soup.
Stir and heat the sauce through, adding cheese and enough water to achieve the desired consistency.
Combine the sauce with cooked spaghetti and serve.

_similar.keywords: spaghetti, bacon, mushroom sauce, creamy pasta

_similar.name: Mushroom Soup
_similar.description: A creamy mushroom soup made with sautéed mushrooms, onions, and garlic in a rich milk-based broth.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute butter, onion, garlic and mushrooms.
Add flour and stir together.
Add stock, sauces and milk.
Simmer until heated through (approximately 15 minutes).
Serve hot.

_similar.keywords: mushroom soup, creamy soup, comfort food

_similar.name: Cheese & Broccoli Soup
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli and cheese soup with a rich, velvety texture.

recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter in a large saucepan.
Cook onions until tender; do not brown.
Add chicken stock and broccoli; bring to a boil.
Whisk in flour and cook for 3 minutes.
Return to heat; cook and stir until mixture thickens.
Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes; do not boil.
Puree mixture until smooth.
Heat through with milk, cheese, and seasonings.

_similar.keywords: broccoli soup, cheese soup, creamy soup
